description: Hand-authored KPI dictionary for the sales_sample gallery example. It labels the numeric measures and supplies the three optional x-qsv KPI hints so `viz smart --dictionary` renders GAUGE and DELTA tiles in the overview row: `gauge_range` [min,max] draws a measure on a canonical scale (here the 0-1 ratios), and `target` draws a "vs target" delta. `aggregation` declares how a measure combines across a group - `unit_price` is per-unit, so it is AVERAGED, never summed. qsv's label heuristic reaches the same verdict for this particular name, but the hint is the authoritative, LANGUAGE-NEUTRAL signal: a heuristic over column names cannot work for every dataset in every language, and `precio_unitario` or `Stueckpreis` is the same measure (issue #4401). NOT LLM-generated - `target` is a business GOAL you choose (describegpt never emits it); `gauge_range` and `aggregation` are what `--dictionary infer` would emit. Columns omitted here fall back to qsv's statistical heuristic.
